building_details.building_ref: No new building, existing club house building

description: Use of the building as a golf centre including a driving range across ground and lower ground floors, ground floor restaurant, bar facility and events space, and lower ground floor bar and restaurant facility and mini golf area, together with regrading and resurfacing of driving range, resurfacing of gravel car park with permeable hard standing, attenuation pond, provision of a total of 100 car parking spaces (10 disabled and 10 electric vehicle charging points), increase in hours of operation, removal of floodlights to driving range and replacement low level lighting, and speakers to driving range.
